summary.text: Data analyst with an economics background (M.Sc.) and experience at Zalando SE, working with SQL, BigQuery, Python and Looker. Comfortable presenting to stakeholders and supporting category managers and the returns team with analyses and dashboards. Contributed to an A/B test analysis for the checkout page.

bullets.text: Helped with an A/B test analysis for the checkout page.
Ran ad-hoc SQL analyses in BigQuery for category managers.
Built weekly Looker dashboards for the returns team.
Cleaned data in Python (pandas) and wrote Excel reports.
